Our process我們的流程

Five stages, each with an end.五個階段，每一個都有終點。

You always know which stage you are in, what it produces, and what it costs before it begins. You can stop after any of them.你永遠知道自己在哪個階段、會拿到什麼、以及開始之前它要多少錢。每一個階段結束後，你都可以停下來。

STAGE 0

Discovery初談

60 minutes · complimentary60 分鐘 · 不收費

Understand your questions, explain the scope of services, confirm mutual fit.了解你的問題、說明服務範圍、確認彼此適合。

STAGE 1

Financial Snapshot財務體檢

Fixed fee · one-time固定費用 · 一次性

Data collection and verification. Six deliverables plus a 90-minute review.資料蒐集與查核。六項產出，含 90 分鐘檢視會談。

STAGE 2

Fixed fee · one-time固定費用 · 一次性

Full-module analysis. Written plan and implementation checklist, with one 90-day follow-up.全模組分析。書面規劃書與執行檢查表，含一次 90 天後追蹤。

STAGE 3

Subscription · quarterly訂閱制 · 按季

Quarterly reviews, unlimited questions, implementation support, annual plan update.每季檢視、問題不限次數、執行支援、年度規劃更新。

STAGE 4

Stage 1 fees are credited in full against Stage 2 if you upgrade within 30 days. Stage 3 requires completion of Stage 2.30 天內升級至第二階段，第一階段費用全額折抵。第三階段需先完成第二階段。

Service fees服務費用

Published, before you ask.先寫出來，不用你開口問。

Every stage is priced on adviser hours and complexity, and set out in writing before it begins.每個階段都以顧問時數與複雜度定價，並在開始之前以書面載明。

Our commitment我們的承諾

All compensation for these services comes exclusively from advisory fees paid directly by clients. We do not accept commissions, rebates, referral fees or non-monetary benefits from any financial product provider. Where implementation requires a product arranged through a third party and a commission is generated, 100% of it is refunded to the client or credited against advisory fees, with written confirmation.本服務的所有報酬，完全來自客戶直接支付的顧問費。我們不接受任何金融商品供應商的佣金、回扣、轉介費或非金錢利益。若執行過程中需要透過第三方安排商品並因此產生佣金，該佣金 100% 退還客戶或折抵顧問費，並提供書面確認。

Complexity surcharge複雜度加價

Each of the following adds 20–30% to Stage 2 and Stage 3 fees. A quotation is provided once engagement is confirmed.以下每一項會使第二、三階段費用增加 20–30%。確認委任後提供報價。

  • Financial assets above S$1,000,000 or TWD 30,000,000金融資產超過 S$1,000,000 或 TWD 30,000,000
  • Cross-border tax or residency involving two or more jurisdictions涉及兩個以上司法管轄區的跨境稅務或居民身分
  • Business owners, self-employed, or holders of private company equity企業主、自營作業者，或持有非上市公司股權
  • Multi-generational legacy or trust arrangements跨世代傳承或信託安排

How fees are determined費用如何決定

  1. Time.時間。 Each stage is priced on actual adviser hours × a professional hourly rate.每個階段以實際顧問時數 × 專業時薪定價。
  2. Complexity.複雜度。 Tiered by asset size, household structure and cross-border elements.依資產規模、家庭結構與跨境因素分級。
  3. Asset size.資產規模。 Stage 4 uses a declining tiered rate — the larger the portfolio, the lower the rate.第四階段採遞減費率——組合越大，費率越低。
  4. Value.價值。 The long-term value created by tax optimisation, behavioural coaching and withdrawal strategy typically exceeds the advisory fee many times over.稅務優化、行為引導與提領策略創造的長期價值，通常數倍於顧問費用。

Payment & termination付款與終止

  • Stages 1 and 2 are payable in full on signing; Stages 3 and 4 are billed quarterly in advance.第一、二階段於簽約時全額支付；第三、四階段按季預先收取。
  • Either party may terminate with 30 days' written notice; fees for services not yet rendered are refunded pro rata.任一方均可提前 30 天以書面終止；尚未提供服務的費用按比例退還。
  • Stage 1 fees are non-refundable once the data collection form has been submitted.資料蒐集表提交後，第一階段費用不予退還。

In Singapore, advice on investment products is provided under the Financial Advisers Act by an appointed representative of a licensed FA firm. In Taiwan, services are limited to financial planning, financial education and insurance needs analysis, and do not include analysis of or recommendations on individual securities. Prices shown are base fees; the final fee is set out in the signed engagement agreement. Prices exclude GST and business tax where applicable.在新加坡，投資商品之建議依《財務顧問法》由持牌財顧公司之委任代表提供。在台灣，服務範圍限於財務規劃、財務教育與保險需求分析，不包含個別有價證券之分析或推介建議。所列價格為基本費用，最終費用以簽署之委任契約為準。價格未含消費稅／營業稅。

About關於

Fresco Su蘇佑成 Fresco Su

For the past twenty years I ran commercial businesses across Asia-Pacific markets: Taiwan, Korea, Hong Kong, and now Singapore. I led teams through market entries, restructurings, social unrest and a pandemic — all the ups and the downs. That career taught me how money behaves under pressure, and how differently people decide when the money is their own.過去二十年，我在亞太市場經營商業業務：台灣、韓國、香港，以及現在的新加坡。我帶著團隊走過市場開拓、組織重整、社會動盪與一場疫情——所有的起起落落。那段職涯讓我看清錢在壓力下的樣子，也看清當賭注是自己的時候，人的判斷會有多不同。

Since 2025 I have been moving towards what I am passionate about: helping like-minded people plan their finances so they can get on with enjoying their lives. I hold the Singapore CACS certification for private banking client advisory, and I am an FPAS-qualified Associate Wealth Planner. Tranquil Solstice Investment Pte. Ltd. exists to do this work with you, paid only by you. No products, no commissions, no reason to prefer one answer over another.2025 年起，我開始轉向自己真正熱愛的事：陪伴理念相近的人把財務安排好，然後好好過生活。我持有新加坡 CACS 私人銀行客戶顧問認證，以及 FPAS 認證的 Associate Wealth Planner 資格。Tranquil Solstice Investment Pte. Ltd. 的存在，是為了陪你把這件事做好——而且只收你的錢。沒有商品、沒有佣金、沒有理由偏好某一個答案。
